turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
Data center demand was exceptional this quarter and we remain supply constrained on our latest AI accelerator platform. Customer demand for AI compute continues to accelerate.
Revenue was $26.0 billion, up 78% year over year. Data center revenue set a record. We expect strong demand to continue into next quarter.
Can you talk about HBM supply and networking bottleneck?
HBM supply remains tight and networking is a bottleneck, but supply is improving. Gross margin was 75%.
